units.title: Implement the typed pre-write evaluator and native adapters
units.objective: Produce attributable allow, observe-violation, and deny decisions for supported native pre-write events without changing host configuration.

included: Strict request, decision, and receipt contracts
Claim/session/worktree/branch/path policy evaluation
Claude and Codex payload adapters
Claim-bound cache and both-sign deterministic tests

outputs: PreWriteRequestV1, PreWriteDecisionV1, and receipt contracts
Typed ownership evaluator and bounded cache
Claude and Codex pre-write adapters with both-sign fixtures

acceptance.criterion: Supported native pre-write fixtures produce exact attributable decisions and cannot reuse an allow after claim or branch identity changes.
evidence_required: ruff and strict mypy on the evaluator and CLI
acceptance.negative_control: Missing, wrong-session, wrong-worktree, wrong-branch, out-of-scope, unhealthy, malformed, and unknown supported-write fixtures deny in enforce mode without mutating the fixture target.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live registry claim for this ready unit and its declared repository paths.

units.title: Record the executable identity of every sanctioned claim mutation
units.objective: Make claim-writer identity directly observable so fleet rollout never infers an executable from a repository path.

included: Additive ClaimMutationReceiptV1 JSONL contract for create, heartbeat, release, prune, session end, and closeout mutations
Canonical runtime source path and SHA-256, operation, target claim, session, registry digest, projection digest, and projection-current result
Deterministic current-runtime, legacy-no-receipt, and audit-write-failure fixtures

outputs: ClaimMutationReceiptV1 append-only local ledger
Query command that groups live claim mutations by runtime source digest
Both-sign provenance and failure tests

dependencies.rationale: Writer provenance extends the accepted mutation and projection contract.

acceptance.criterion: Every sanctioned mutation with an available ledger emits one terminal receipt identifying the exact loaded coordination runtime and whether its resulting projection matches the registry; unavailable-ledger failure returns mutation_applied_audit_failed nonzero.
evidence_required: Query output for one real heartbeat
Failure test proving an unwritable receipt path fails visibly after reporting mutation outcome
acceptance.negative_control: A legacy mutation with no receipt remains unknown and cannot be classified as current.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Claim only the canonical mutation contract, query, tests, and Plan 108 evidence paths.

units.title: Freeze the active claim-writer fleet and mechanical dispositions
units.objective: Produce a timestamped fleet manifest in which every live writer is current, legacy, inactive, or authority-blocked without operator interpretation.

included: Query the global live-claim registry and mutation ledger
Record canonical repo, remote owner, runtime source digest, active sessions, and disposition
Fail closed on missing provenance or conflicting identities
excluded: Treating file presence as proof of the executing runtime

outputs: docs/evidence/plan108_pw02b_fleet_inventory.json with one row per active writer digest

dependencies.rationale: Fleet identity must come from runtime receipts rather than repository inference.

conflict_surfaces.target: shared claim registry and claim-mutation ledger

acceptance.criterion: Every live mutation runtime has exactly one mechanical disposition: update_current_personal, already_current, inactive, or authority_blocked.
evidence_required: Timestamped manifest with source SHA-256 and active-session IDs
acceptance.negative_control: A fixture writer without provenance produces unclassified_legacy and fails acceptance.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Writer-provenance unit accepted; claim only fleet inventory and evidence paths.

units.title: Route the native Codex pre-write gate through apply_patch
units.objective: Make the already-accepted Codex pre-write adapter reachable by generated hook wiring without enabling hard enforcement.

included: Move the canonical Codex pre-write command from the stale Edit|Write matcher to apply_patch during preserving generation
Preserve unrelated user hook commands and matcher blocks
Both-sign generator and migration regression tests
excluded: Broadening the adapter to arbitrary shell writes

outputs: Correct generated Codex apply_patch matcher
Preserving stale-matcher migration
Focused generator regression evidence

dependencies.rationale: The repair routes the accepted adapter and does not redefine its contract.

acceptance.criterion: Generated Codex wiring invokes the canonical pre-write adapter for apply_patch, removes only that canonical command from a stale Edit|Write block, and preserves unrelated hooks.
evidence_required: Negative migration fixture with an unrelated Edit|Write hook
acceptance.negative_control: Regeneration must not delete an unrelated hook, enable enforcement, or route unsupported Codex tools through the pre-write adapter.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Claim only the hook generator, its focused tests, and Plan 108 evidence/status paths.

units.title: Update every eligible active writer from the frozen fleet manifest
units.objective: Apply the bounded refresh profile only to manifest rows marked update_current_personal and retain exact per-repository proof.

included: One exact target-repository claim and linked worktree per eligible manifest row
Dry-run, bounded installer apply, targeted tests, real heartbeat, commit, PR, merge, and sanctioned closeout
Per-row revision, PR, command, digest, and rollback evidence

outputs: Merged bounded refresh for each eligible manifest row
Per-repository projection-current heartbeat evidence

dependencies.rationale: The frozen manifest removes target-selection judgment.

acceptance.criterion: Every update_current_personal row is merged and closed, and its real heartbeat leaves projection_is_current true.
evidence_required: Installer dry-run showing only bounded profile paths
acceptance.negative_control: Any dry-run containing hooks, Makefile, enforcement mode, or an unclaimed path stops that target without applying changes.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Inventory accepted; target row equals update_current_personal; exact target paths are claimed before mutation.

units.title: Compile and consume a low-latency claim authority projection
units.objective: Keep YAML claims authoritative while making each fresh native hook decision from an exact digest-bound projection fast enough for the approved latency gate.

included: Atomic digest-bound projection of canonical normalized live claims
Dependency-light native hook evaluator behind the existing decision contract
Projection refresh on every sanctioned claim mutation and explicit recovery command
Canonical-versus-fast parity, corruption, staleness, lifecycle, and latency fixtures
excluded: A second claim authority or permissive fallback
Arbitrary shell or operating-system write containment

outputs: PreWriteAuthorityProjectionV1 and atomically generated local projection
One dependency-light decision engine shared by the typed facade and native CLI
Deterministic projection refresh and fail-loud stale-state recovery
Identical 50-authorized/10-violation calibration readout

dependencies.rationale: The fast path must preserve the accepted request, decision, receipt, and policy semantics.

acceptance.criterion: The dependency-light engine and typed canonical facade return equivalent reason codes and decisions for exact, missing, ambiguous, wrong-session, wrong-repository, wrong-worktree, wrong-branch, out-of-scope, stale-heartbeat, expired, merged, missing-worktree, corrupt-projection, and digest-mismatch fixtures.
evidence_required: Failing tests committed or demonstrated before implementation
ruff and strict mypy on changed Python files
acceptance.negative_control: A missing, corrupt, or digest-mismatched projection is an observe violation or enforce denial and never invokes the slow YAML evaluator as a fallback.

acceptance.criterion: The unchanged full fresh-process calibration classifies 50 authorized and 10 violation controls with zero false blocks at p95 below 100 ms and p99 below 200 ms.
evidence_required: Versioned calibration JSON with all 60 receipt IDs and exact command/config identity
Aggregate latency plus step-down to each concrete decision receipt
acceptance.negative_control: Mutating a claim after projection generation invalidates the next authorization until an explicit canonical refresh succeeds.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live registry claim for this ready unit and every declared repository path.

units.title: Wire observe mode and calibrate correctness and latency
units.objective: Install preserving observe-mode wiring, retain concrete decision receipts, and determine whether hard enforcement can meet the approved correctness and latency bars.

included: Preserving hook generator and governed-repo audit
Explicit observe-mode configuration
Deterministic latency calibration and representative live payload receipts
Operator documentation and rollback

outputs: Idempotent observe-mode hook wiring and audit
Latency and false-block calibration receipt
Exact promotion or stop recommendation

dependencies.rationale: Live calibration must use the accepted evaluator and adapter contract.
Observe-mode promotion must use the accepted low-latency path rather than the known slow YAML path.

conflict_surfaces.target: explicitly reviewed local client hook configuration

acceptance.criterion: Observe-mode wiring preserves unrelated hooks, never blocks, and emits attributable receipts whose local evaluator latency is p95 below 100 ms and p99 below 200 ms with zero false-block classifications on representative compliant writes.
evidence_required: Deterministic calibration JSON with concrete receipt IDs
acceptance.negative_control: Malformed identity and unclaimed/out-of-scope writes remain observable violations rather than being silently allowed as authorized.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: PW-01 accepted and exact host or repository write surfaces declared in a fresh claim.

units.title: Make existing-session claim upserts projection-safe and attributable
units.objective: Ensure every sanctioned update of an existing live session claim atomically refreshes the digest-bound projection and emits an exact receipt before hard enforcement certification.

included: Existing-claim update path in enforced_planning/session_lifecycle.py
Typed mutation-operation contract needed to distinguish an existing-claim upsert
Focused both-sign regression tests and Plan 108 evidence/status paths
excluded: Changing claim ownership or path-conflict policy
Editing other repositories or host hook configuration

inputs.id: Plan 108 final-certification control: existing session upsert writes YAML without projection refresh or receipt

outputs: An atomic existing-session upsert that refreshes projection and emits a session_upsert receipt
Regression proof that the receipt and projection reflect the updated claim state

acceptance.criterion: Updating an existing exact-session claim refreshes the shared projection and emits one session_upsert receipt with equal registry and projection digests; a forced receipt-write failure is reported visibly after the mutation rather than concealed.
evidence_required: Exact durable receipt and digest readback from the claimed implementation lane
acceptance.negative_control: A missing or failed receipt append returns mutation_applied_audit_failed and never reports the mutation as absent.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Fresh exact claim owns only the named lifecycle, receipt-contract, test, evidence, and Plan-status paths.

units.title: Certify the refreshed fleet and close the stale-projection gate
units.objective: Prove the complete active sanctioned writer fleet cannot leave the shared projection stale before hard enforcement is allowed.

included: Fresh post-rollout inventory with zero unclassified or update-pending writers
Create, heartbeat, release, and closeout projection-current readbacks
A retained fleet version/digest and mutation evidence report
One native observe-mode exact-claim allow after the four mutation controls
excluded: Adding a resident daemon or a slow hook fallback
Changing claim authority away from the YAML registry

outputs: Certified final fleet manifest with no unknown active writer
Retained create/heartbeat/release/closeout projection-current probe

dependencies.rationale: Certification runs only after every eligible fleet update is merged and closed.
Existing session upserts are sanctioned live claim mutations and must not bypass projection refresh or durable provenance.

conflict_surfaces.target: active governed repositories that provide sanctioned claim-mutation entrypoints
shared claim registry and digest-bound projection

acceptance.criterion: The fresh fleet manifest has no unclassified or update-pending active writer, and create, heartbeat, release, and closeout probes each leave projection_is_current true.
evidence_required: Final fleet inventory with runtime receipt identity and source digest
Per-runtime merged update, already-current, inactive, or authority-blocked disposition
Four mutation receipts with projection digest readback
Post-probe native observe allow with no projection_unavailable_or_stale result
acceptance.negative_control: A deliberately retained legacy fixture is detected as noncompliant and cannot satisfy the promotion guard.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: PW-02B2 accepted; claim only final fleet evidence and Plan 108 status paths.

units.title: Promote enforced-planning to hard pre-write enforcement and prove rollback
units.objective: Enable enforcement only after accepted calibration, then prove unauthorized native writes are stopped before mutation and exact claimed writes still succeed.

included: The enforced-planning repository only
Exact enforce-mode configuration change
Real positive and negative file-hash probes
Rollback and retained receipts

outputs: Enforced native Codex apply_patch path in enforced-planning
Positive and negative native write receipts
Verified observe/off rollback

dependencies.rationale: Hard enforcement is permitted only after the observe-mode correctness and latency bars pass.
Hard enforcement would create intermittent false denials while any active claim writer can leave the shared projection stale.
The real Codex pilot requires generated wiring that actually matches native apply_patch events.

conflict_surfaces.target: enforced-planning/meta-process.yaml and installed native hook configuration

acceptance.criterion: In enforced-planning, an out-of-scope native edit attempt against README.md is denied with unchanged SHA-256, an exact claimed edit to tests/fixtures/prewrite_live_probe.txt succeeds, and rollback restores claims.prewrite_mode=observe.
evidence_required: Real native negative-control receipt and unchanged before/after hash
Real native positive-control receipt and expected diff
acceptance.negative_control: A missing registry, malformed identity, or stale claim must not be converted into an allow decision in enforce mode.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: PW-02 and PW-02B accepted and the target repository/configuration paths declared in a fresh exact claim.

units.title: Promote every authorized active governed repository to hard pre-write enforcement
units.objective: Make unclaimed native edits fail before mutation across the authorized governed fleet, with explicit exceptions instead of implicit off state.

included: Fresh active governed-repository target manifest from Project Meta repository governance
One exact claimed configuration and generated-hook rollout lane per authorized repository
Per-repository enforce-mode and adapter audit readback
Representative both-sign native canaries for each distinct client/configuration shape
Explicit evidence-backed exceptions with owner and resume event
excluded: Archived, vendored, external, or unauthorized repositories
Force-push, deployment, package publication, or non-Git publication
Closing or discarding pre-existing dirty work

outputs: Frozen governed-fleet enforcement manifest
Merged per-repository enforce configuration and generated adapters
Fleet audit with no implicit off repository
Representative native denial and exact-claim allow receipts

dependencies.rationale: Fleet promotion starts only after the fixed repository pilot proves denial, allow, and rollback through the real native boundary.

conflict_surfaces.target: authorized governed repository configuration and generated hook surfaces

acceptance.criterion: Every authorized active governed repository in the frozen manifest has enforce-mode configuration and current generated native adapters, or an explicit evidence-backed exception with owner and resume event; no row is implicitly off or unclassified.
evidence_required: Per-repository claim, merge revision, closeout receipt, and audit readback
Representative native exact-claim allow and unclaimed-write denial receipts
acceptance.negative_control: An unauthorized, archived, missing, dirty, or actively claimed repository remains unchanged and is reported explicitly rather than counted as enforced.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: PW-03 accepted; each target matches the frozen governance manifest and receives one exact non-overlapping claim before mutation.
